{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
print("Number of internal test orders detected:", internal_test_mask.sum())

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df['status'] == 'refunded')
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_mask.sum())

# Filter for completed orders that are not internal test orders
completed_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (~internal_test_mask)]

# Calculate total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
